pricing.perCourseNote: per course, depending on the course

benefits.liveBody: Evening classes online and hands-on Saturday workshops in Kigali, with an instructor who knows your name.
benefits.practicalBody: Most of your time is spent in Excel, Power BI, SQL, Python and R on real datasets from shops, clinics and cooperatives.
benefits.capstoneBody: Finish with a solved problem and a portfolio piece, not only a certificate.
benefits.progressBody: Resume where you stopped, track every lesson and grade, and get your certificate automatically when you pass.
benefits.tutorBody: Ask the AI tutor at any hour, and talk with your cohort and facilitators in your course's Discord community.
benefits.languageBody: The whole platform works in both languages, so you learn in the one you think in.
benefits.title: Learning that fits a working life
benefits.body: Built for professionals, students and NGO teams across Rwanda and Francophone Africa.
benefits.body2: Built for working professionals, students and NGO teams.
benefits.capstoneBody2: Courses with a capstone end with a real problem worked through the five-step framework and marked by your instructor.
benefits.feedbackBody: Marked work comes back with comments from your instructor, not only a number.
benefits.languageBody2: Menus, pages and messages are in both languages. Each course page states the language it is taught in.
benefits.practicalBody2: You practise on real datasets from shops, clinics and cooperatives, in the tools each course teaches.
benefits.progressBody2: Resume where you stopped and follow every lesson and grade. Certificates carry a code anyone can check online.

steps.enrolBody: Pick a course and pay with Mobile Money, in full or in two instalments.
steps.learnBody: Watch lessons, join live sessions and practise with quizzes and assignments.
steps.buildBody: Apply the five-step framework to a real problem, with feedback from your instructor.
steps.certifyBody: Score 65% or more on the capstone and receive a certificate anyone can verify online.

steps.title: From your first lesson to a certificate

steps.enrolBody2: Pick a course and pay by Mobile Money, in full or, where the course offers it, in two instalments.
steps.learnBody2: Work through the lessons, join live sessions if your course has them, and complete the work it sets.

capstone.body: Courses with a capstone end with a real problem worked through the five-step framework and marked by your instructor. A mark of 65% or more earns the certificate.
capstone.photo1: Four learners gather around one laptop to work through a problem together
capstone.photo2: Learners discuss their work at shared desks with their laptops open
capstone.step1Body: Name the decision someone has to make and the question the data must answer.
capstone.step2Body: Find and clean the data that bears on that question.
capstone.step3Body: Choose the tools and methods the course taught that fit the problem.
capstone.step4Body: Work through the data and show what it says.
capstone.step5Body: Turn the findings into actions the decision maker can take.
capstone.title: The capstone

faq.body: Answers from our terms and course pages.
faq.certificateA: Meet the course's pass requirements, which include 65% on the capstone where there is one. Each certificate carries a code that anyone can check on the verification page.
faq.certificateQ: How do I earn a certificate, and can an employer check it?
faq.languageA: The platform works in English and French. Each course page states the language the course is taught in.
faq.languageQ: Which language are courses taught in?
faq.paymentA: By MTN Mobile Money or Airtel Money. Cohort courses can be paid in two instalments.
faq.refundsA: Refund requests must be made within 7 days of purchase and are considered case by case, as set out in the terms of service.
faq.scheduleA: Cohort courses run evening classes online and hands-on Saturday workshops in Kigali. Where a course has an upcoming cohort, its start date is shown on the course card.
faq.scholarshipA: Some courses offer scholarships. The course page shows whether you can apply.
faq.teamsA: Yes. Organisations can sponsor places or enrol a group into a dedicated cohort. Use the form above to tell us what you need.

tracks.careerExplain: Longer pathways toward a role, with the competencies it needs, recommended courses and applied projects. They prepare you for a role; they are not a job offer or placement.

tracks.notFoundBody: It may have been renamed or unpublished.
tracks.progressNote: Counted from the courses you complete. Courses you finished before joining the track count too.
tracks.skillExplain: Short and focused: a few courses that together build one skill, such as SQL for analysis. Usually a few weeks.
tracks.title: Skill and career tracks
